items.name: auto-ontology
items.description: Auto Ontology is a Python framework for building semantic, graph-based reasoning layers over data. It enables deterministic query generation, better context retrieval, and more explainable AI for LLM and agent workflows.

readme.excerpt:
Agents can retrieve documents and query databases, but reliability gates agentic analytics: a revenue metric answered faster is worth nothing if the number is wrong. Agents need a context layer that tells them where data lives, what it means, whether to use it, how to use it, where it came from, and what is similar. NVIDIA Auto Ontology is an open library that builds that layer from enterprise metadata, reconciles definitions across systems, and exposes it to any agent harness through MCP, CLI, and API. It complements the semantic models customers already own.

- Discover: generate enterprise ontologies from metadata; connect existing ontologies and semantic models; build AI-ready knowledge graphs. - Ground: give agents trusted business meaning for metrics, entities, and relationships; reconcile inconsistent definitions across systems. - Validate: check generated queries against certified definitions and lineage; return provenance with every answer. - Expose: serve context to any agent harness through MCP, CLI, and API. Learn: fold certified corrections and usage back into the ontology, so shared context improves with every question.

To run a text-to-SQL benchmark such as BIRD, refer to the ontology SQL evaluation repository.

readme.excerpt:
Project NOMAD is a self-contained, offline-first knowledge and education server packed with critical tools, knowledge, and AI to keep you informed and empowered — anytime, anywhere.

Project NOMAD can be installed on any Debian-based operating system (we recommend Ubuntu 26.04 LTS; 24.04 LTS and Debian 12 are also supported). items.name: slimdeer
items.description: Smaller images, same picture. Compress PNGs to PNG or WebP with automatic quality. PNG output is 8–12% smaller than TinyPNG at equal quality on the median image. Command line and browser.

readme.excerpt:
Smaller images. Same picture. slimdeer makes PNG and JPEG images smaller, or turns them into WebP and AVIF, with no quality slider: for each image it searches for the smallest file whose perceptual score still reaches a target picked for that image. A PNG becomes the palette PNG that does (palette sizes from 2 to 256 colors, with and without dithering): at the same quality, the median image comes out 8–12% smaller than with TinyPNG , the best result of any open-source compressor we've measured. slimdeer was called pngdeer until version 0.3.0.

Try it in your browser → Nothing is uploaded: images are compressed on your device.

brew install heydeer/tap/slimdeer slimdeer logo.png photo.jpg writes logo.min.png and photo.min.jpg

items.description: 一个基于 Go 语言的全网音乐搜索与下载工具。支持 CLI 命令行与 Web 服务双模式，内置网易云、QQ、酷狗、Bilibili、汽水音乐等 10+ 个主流平台，支持多源并发搜索与无损音质解析。music-dl交流群：755087923

readme.excerpt:
Go Music DL 是一个多平台音乐搜索与下载工具，支持 Web 、 TUI 和 桌面端 ，覆盖单曲、歌单、专辑、排行榜与本地音乐。它同时暴露了一套 AI 可调用的接口—— AI 可以直接操控你正开着的网页播放器 ，点歌、切歌、暂停、调音量都不用你动手，详见 AI / Agent 调用。

- Windows / Linux / macOS：从 Releases 下载 music-dl-desktop-rust 或 music-dl-desktop-go 对应平台包，解压后直接运行。 - Android：优先下载 music-dl arm64-v8a.apk ，已内置 FFmpeg，无需额外安装。 - iOS：使用 music-dl-ios-unsigned.ipa 自行签名。

Web 的搜索、试听、下载和歌单浏览无需登录；修改设置或 Cookie 时才需要管理员账号。首次配置时，启动日志会打印 Web setup token ，用它创建管理员账号即可。TUI 常用键： ↑/↓ 移动、 空格 选择、 a 全选、 r 换源、 Enter 下载、 w 每日推荐、 q 退出。
features: Windows / Linux / macOS：从 Releases 下载 music-dl-desktop-rust 或 music-dl-desktop-go 对应平台包，解压后直接运行。
Android：优先下载 music-dl arm64-v8a.apk ，已内置 FFmpeg，无需额外安装。
iOS：使用 music-dl-ios-unsigned.ipa 自行签名。
连接时带 ?client id=xxx 声明身份；老页面匿名连上来后，第一次上报状态时会被自动认领。
POST /play 和 /command 带 client id 就只投给那一台；只有 1 台在线时自动定向，一条 curl 照样能用。
多台在线又不带 client id → 返回 409 ambiguous client 和候选列表，绝不并发让所有页面一起切歌。
GET /state 不带参数时优先选择在线、正在播放、页面可见的客户端，同类按连接顺序稳定选择，不会被 2 秒一次的状态上报带着来回跳； GET /state?client id=xxx 精确读取某一台。
每台客户端分别保存 last command ，查询某台不会混入其他客户端的命令。

items.name: cicada
items.description: 知了 Cicada · 任何会议和直播的实时字幕、同声传译、AI 会议纪要，Mac、Windows、Linux、Android 免费开源。Live subtitles, interpreting and meeting notes for any call or stream, on Mac, Windows, Linux and Android.

readme.excerpt:
任何会议、任何直播，没有语言障碍。 听得懂，说得出，记得住。Mac、Windows、Linux 和 Android 上的实时纪要、双语文字记录、字幕与同声传译。

无论是用 Zoom、飞书、腾讯会议开会，还是听 X Spaces 和 YouTube 直播，知了都能实时给出双语字幕、边听边写结构化纪要。遇到需要发言的时候，按住说话键（Mac 上是右 ⌥ ，Windows 上是右 Ctrl ）开口，对方就能在会里直接听到翻译好的语音。知了直接读取系统声音，不用往会里塞机器人，对方完全无感；在 Mac 上还全部在本机识别，声音不出电脑。

四个平台共用一个版本号和同一种会议记录格式，安装包都在 官网下载页 和 Releases。下面的功能说明以 Mac 版为准。
features: 联网与虚拟麦克风 。只有翻译（ translate.googleapis.com ）、填了 key 后的 Ling / Ming（ api.ant-ling.com ）、下载 BlackHole 驱动和每天去 GitHub 检查一次新版本会联网。BlackHole 从官方下载已经
没有统计和自建服务器 。应用没有统计、没有埋点，也没有我们自己的服务器，诊断功能只把耗时和次数记在本机会议文件夹里。
本机数据位置 。会议记录、录音和纪要存在 ~/Library/Application Support/LiveSubs 。Ling key 和你录的声音样本只对当前系统账户可读，不进 Time Machine 备份，也不写进日志和导出文件。
共享屏幕看不到纪要窗口 。屏幕共享、录屏和截图都拍不到它，要录演示时可以打开“共享屏幕时让对方看到”。
打开 Ling 开放平台，注册或登录。
点创建令牌，复制以 sk- 开头的那串 key。
在知了里打开设置里的 AI 服务，粘贴后点保存并检查，也可以直接粘贴到纪要窗口顶部的提示框里。知了会发一个只用一个 token 的请求确认 key 可用。
同一页面可以选模型（默认 Ling-3.1-flash ），每种语言用哪个 Ming 声音在同声传译设置里选。想移除 key，在同一页面点移除即可。

Download · Getting started · User guide · Contribute

ZapFast is a WhatsApp client written in Rust with egui and fastframe, the framework behind a family of native desktop apps. It links to your phone as a companion device through whatsapp-rust and has no browser engine. The interface is available in English, Chinese (Simplified and Traditional), French, German, Indonesian, Italian, Portuguese (Brazil), Russian, Spanish, and Turkish.

items.name: nvidia-macos-driver
items.description: Metal driver for NVIDIA GeForce cards on macOS Sequoia

readme.excerpt:
A Metal driver for NVIDIA GeForce cards on macOS 15 Sequoia (Intel Macs and OpenCore PCs). It is open source; the kernel extensions, the Metal plugin and the shader translator are in this repository. The 1401 app that installs it (Mac and Windows) is its own project: 1401.

Supported cards are Turing and newer: GTX 16, RTX 20, 30, 40 and 50, TITAN RTX, Quadro RTX and the T-series. Most testing is done on an RTX 5060, so other cards may have problems that haven't been found yet. See card support for what has been reported working.
